newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill cuts two airline stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill cuts two airline stocks.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it downgraded United Airlines parent UAL Corp to near-term neutral from buy, and to long-term accumulate from buy.
-- Lowered Alaska Air Group Inc was lowered to near-term neutral from accumulate, and to long-term accumulate from buy.
-- The analyst was not immediately available for details.
-- UAL Corp fell 1-7/8 to 72-1/2. Alaska Air dropped 1-1/4 to 23-5/8.
